objective_contribution: Test whether bounded observable evidence improves the reasoning trajectory when delivered early enough to change exploration.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does one bounded evidence-guidance projection immediately after the first receipt-confirmed pinned-base read improve GLM-5.3-flash useful context selection at 8K without exceeding the paired token ceiling?

experiment_and_task_refs.unresolved: Scorer adaptation, full local validation, fresh selection, repositories, scorer smoke, preflight, freeze, live run, score, and decision.

measurement_mapping.native: H58 quality uses the fixed eight-identity denominator; bounded failures produce symmetric arm zeros.
measurement_mapping.retention: One first-evidence guidance projection is the sole semantic treatment after an exact shared delivery boundary.
measurement_mapping.integrity: The first read must be bound to the confirming request receipt; the held response has no effects; H63 remains the failure-accounting policy.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Known model input plus output usage plus the full admitted input-plus-output reservation for each indeterminate call; never zero-imputed.
measurement_mapping.transfer: The projection uses delivered evidence and observable task agreement, making the mechanism model and domain portable; this run remains GLM code-context evidence.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window chapter before larger windows
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: Continue independent tasks only after a validator-proven bounded local failure; any boundary, effect, ancestry, guidance, or unknown-cost violation stops globally.
